blocks.text: From quiet moments at home to dining, shopping and leisure around Cebu’s South Road Properties, Sanremo Oasis brings different parts of everyday living within reach. A quiet morning at home, an afternoon spent shopping, or an evening out for dinner—sometimes, the appeal of a neighborhood lies in how easily it accommodates the different rhythms of everyday life. At Cebu’s South Road Properties (SRP), a growing mix of residential communities, shopping destinations, entertainment venues and open spaces is shaping how people experience this part of the city.
